workflowSummary: A coaching institute admin qualifies admission inquiries from WhatsApp, copies details into a spreadsheet, tracks status/payment/follow-up, and sends manual reply templates.

sourceEvidence.observation: Incoming WhatsApp admission inquiry is visible with student details being reviewed.
Lead details are transferred into a spreadsheet-like tracker.
Admin updates status and prepares follow-up/payment message.

steps.title: Read incoming inquiry
steps.output: Admission intent and contact details identified

steps.title: Capture lead details
steps.input: Name, phone, age, course interest, batch preference

steps.title: Qualify the lead
steps.output: Lead status and follow-up status set

entities.name: Lead
entities.label: Lead
entities.description: A student or parent inquiry for a coaching institute course.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Parent asked for evening batch fee details.

painPoints: Lead details are copied manually between WhatsApp and spreadsheets.
Follow-up and payment statuses can be missed when many inquiries arrive.
Repeated WhatsApp replies are typed or copied one by one.

messageTemplates.name: First reply
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{studentName}}, thanks for your interest in {{course}}. Can you confirm your preferred batch timing?

messageTemplates.name: Fee details
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{studentName}}, the fee details for {{course}} are ready. We can share the payment link once you confirm the batch.

messageTemplates.name: Follow-up reminder
messageTemplates.body: Hi {{studentName}}, just checking if you would like to confirm your {{course}} admission for the upcoming batch.

screens.name: Lead intake
screens.description: Capture a new inquiry without switching to a spreadsheet.

screens.name: Admissions dashboard
screens.description: Track lead, payment, and follow-up status in one place.

screens.name: WhatsApp templates
screens.description: Copy consistent messages for common follow-ups.

clarifyingQuestions.question: What lead statuses should this tool use?
Which fields are required before saving a lead?
Do you need payment tracking in this tool?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: Yes, track Not sent, Pending, and Paid

clarifyingQuestions.question: Which WhatsApp messages do you send most often?
clarifyingQuestions.defaultAnswer: First reply, fee details, and follow-up reminder
